steps.what: Show the programme already set for this concert or recital.
Perform before live audiences in concerts, recitals, and educational presentations.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the programme already set for the concert, recital, or educational presentation. The musician performs it before the live audience, including other social gatherings on the same booking. The programme does not perform the music. An event with no programme leaves the screen blank, and the musician plays what was agreed in the room.
tasks.previous_blocker: The order of pieces was a paper programme, and a change was announced from the stage.
tasks.enabler_now: The written programme can be shown. Performing for the audience cannot leave the room.
tasks.still_hard: A live audience, and the pacing of a recital, stay with the musician on the night.
tasks.human_edge: The musician performs. The programme is the order already chosen, not the playing.
tasks.altitude: Performance stays in front of the audience. The programme is visible and is not treated as the concert.

reach.task: Perform a piece for people in the room.
reach.learn: The running order is not the performance.

evidence.claim: Showing a programme already set is a lookup of piece names. It does not perform the concert or the recital.
Identifying tracks after a show is a different job from playing them. It is not counted as the musician's performance.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A musician or singer in a mid-size European company. A score on screen is not a performance, and a draft note is not the research.
Fields: The event id and the programme only if it is already set. Pieces are not added by the screen. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the musician finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the programme from the document store before printing another copy.
unknowns: Whether educational presentations use the same programme format as concerts.
research_questions: Who changes the programme after the audience is seated?

already_counted.description: Performing for the audience stays with the musician.

incremental.description: Drop programmes for events that have already taken place.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The musician still performs before the live audience. Only showing a programme that was already set is removed. An event with no programme saves nothing of the performance.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Practise pieces and keep the skill.

steps.what: Show the piece assigned for this practice or rehearsal.
Practice performances individually or in rehearsal with other musicians.
Keep at the piece until it is mastered or the skill is maintained.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the piece already assigned for practice. The musician practises alone or in rehearsal with other musicians, to master the piece or to maintain the skill. The assignment does not practise. A week with no assigned piece leaves the screen blank, and the musician chooses the piece in the room.
tasks.previous_blocker: The piece for rehearsal was a message, and mastery was judged only by the next performance.
tasks.enabler_now: The assigned piece can be shown. The practice itself is unchanged.
tasks.still_hard: Hearing whether a piece is mastered takes the musician, alone or with the others.
tasks.human_edge: The musician practises and decides the piece is not yet mastered.
tasks.altitude: Practice stays with the musician. The assigned piece is shown, and the judgement of mastery is unchanged.

reach.task: Rehearse a scene until it holds.
reach.learn: The call sheet does not do the rehearsal.

evidence.claim: Showing an assigned piece is a lookup. It does not practise the music or improve the skill.
Mastery is the musician's own sense of the piece. A practice log does not declare it.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A musician or singer in a mid-size European company. A score on screen is not a performance, and a draft note is not the research.
Fields: The piece id if one is already assigned. The screen does not choose the piece. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the musician finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the assignment from the document store before making a practice diary.
unknowns: Whether rehearsal time with other musicians is scheduled by this musician or by a fixer.
research_questions: Who decides that a piece is mastered before the concert?

already_counted.description: Practising and judging mastery stay with the musician.

incremental.description: Clear piece assignments for rehearsals that were cancelled.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The musician still practises alone or with others and still judges whether the piece is mastered. Only showing a piece already assigned is removed. A week with no assignment saves nothing.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Keep to one family of instruments.

steps.what: Show the instrument family already named on this musician's engagements.
Specialize in playing a specific family of instruments or a particular type of music.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the instrument family or the type of music already named on this musician's own engagements. The musician keeps playing that specialty. The record does not assign a new family or a new type of music. A musician with no stored family leaves the screen blank.
tasks.previous_blocker: The specialty was known to the fixer by memory, and a call for the wrong instrument arrived late.
tasks.enabler_now: The family already on the engagements can be shown. Choosing and playing the specialty stay with the musician.
tasks.still_hard: A list of past calls does not decide what this musician should specialize in next.
tasks.human_edge: The musician plays the specialty. The record only repeats what engagements already say.
tasks.altitude: The specialty stays the musician's playing. The screen shows the family already on past engagements and does not assign a new one.

reach.task: Keep to a kind of work they have already done.
reach.learn: A list of past jobs is not a new specialty.

evidence.claim: Reading the instrument family off engagements already stored is a lookup. It does not specialize the playing.
Assigning a new family or a new type of music would be a decision the past engagements do not contain.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A musician or singer in a mid-size European company. A score on screen is not a performance, and a draft note is not the research.
Fields: The musician id and the family only if an engagement already names it. The family is not inferred. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the musician finishes it by hand.
Native check: Read the engagements from the document store before building a profile.
unknowns: Whether one musician is booked across more than one instrument family.
research_questions: Who may add an instrument family to the engagement record?

already_counted.description: Playing the specialty stays with the musician.

incremental.description: Correct the family when an engagement named the wrong instrument.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The musician still plays the specialty. Only showing a family already named on an engagement is removed. A musician with no stored family saves nothing, and no new specialty is assigned.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Play with the orchestra or the band.

steps.what: Show the musical group and whether this call is as guest artist.
Play musical instruments as soloists, members, or guest artists of orchestras, ensembles, or bands.

tasks.design: The {CALENDAR} shows which musical group made the call, and whether the musician is booked as a member or a guest artist. The musician plays the instrument as soloist or with the orchestra, ensemble, or band. The call does not play the part. A call with no group name leaves the screen blank.
tasks.previous_blocker: The seat and the guest status were in a mail, and the part was collected at the venue.
tasks.enabler_now: The group and the guest flag can be shown from the booking. Playing the part is unchanged.
tasks.still_hard: Fitting a part inside an orchestra or a band still happens in the room with the other players.
tasks.human_edge: The musician plays the part. The booking only says which group and which seat.
tasks.altitude: Playing with the group stays in the room. The booking shows the group and the guest flag, and it does not play the part.

reach.task: Take a part in a company they are visiting.
reach.learn: The call sheet does not play the part.

evidence.claim: A booking can show the group and whether the call is as a guest. It does not play the instrument.
Solo, member, and guest are labels on the call. They are not the performance.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A musician or singer in a mid-size European company. A score on screen is not a performance, and a draft note is not the research.

Fields: The call id, the group name, and the guest flag only if the booking already has them. The seat is not invented. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the musician finishes it by hand.
Native check: Read the call from the calendar already used for engagements before making a new diary.
unknowns: Whether orchestras, ensembles, and bands share one booking record.
research_questions: Who sets the seat, the fixer or the section leader?

already_counted.description: Playing the part with the group stays with the musician.

incremental.description: Clear guest flags on calls that were cancelled.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The musician still plays as soloist, member, or guest with the group. Only showing the group and the guest flag already on the booking is removed. A call with no group saves nothing.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The musician still performs, still practises, and still plays with the group. A programme or a piece list already written can be opened. It does not play the music.
reach: Actors perform for a live audience, and this job learns the audience is in the room.
Audio and video technicians run the sound, and this job learns the playing stays with the musician.
skills_to_grow: Perform the concert rather than follow a list of pieces as if it were the playing.
Practise the piece until it is mastered, alone or in rehearsal.
Play the instrument the engagement already names.
role.ambitious_version: Concerts, rehearsals, and ensemble playing stay with the musician. A stored programme only shows what was already chosen.
